lines.text: The dark rainstorm stops, the golden sun peeks out, and look high up in the blue sky!
A glowing ribbon of red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, and violet!
Where did those brilliant colors come from? Sunlight looks completely white!
White light is actually a team of all seven colors traveling together!
Millions of floating raindrops act like tiny glass prism mirrors!
When sunlight enters a raindrop, it slows down and bends—a trick called refraction!
Red light bends the least, while violet light bends the most!
The colors separate and bounce back into your eyes as a majestic circular arch!
Discover nature's brilliant art—subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
